decisions.reason: The reusable citrus harvesting crate builds on the firm's established reusable-crate know-how and can still be improved through learning, but its crop-specific niche and weaker recent visibility raise the risk of eventual withdrawal.
A medium-duty rackable pallet remains very close to the firm's core pallet and logistics capabilities, so absorptive capacity is high and continued refinement is more likely than exit.

The spill-retention pallet uses adjacent pallet expertise and safety-oriented engineering the firm can absorb and develop, yet its narrower specialist market makes it the most exposed of the remaining products short of an immediate drop decision.
This plastic pallet with load retainers is an incremental extension of the firm's pallet platform, which supports ongoing commercialization and adaptation and keeps withdrawal risk relatively low.
